Class ConnectionRequestStatusEvent

java.lang.Object
org.cyrus.api.event.network.status.ConnectionRequestStatusEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEvent, IEvent.Cancelable
public class ConnectionRequestStatusEvent extends Object implements IEvent.Cancelable
**This should be a interface**

A Cyrus event that is triggered when a client requests information from the server. This is typically done either by a user opening up the "Multiplayer" screen on the client, and they have the IP of a server already defined. Whereby the client will automatically ping the server as well as gain the information required. The other typical way is clicking the "refresh" button on the "multiplayer" screen within the minecraft client
